runtime: One local Node process, direct typed calls and no hosted service. Ordinary SQLite transactions are distinct from fenced staged store replacement.

sources.basis: Static inspection of the successor working-tree source identifies this implementation binding. It does not establish passing tests, installed availability, publication or engineering approval. Prior observations remain recoverable at 39be9c81.

lifecycles.name: Store maintenance coordination

states.name: Available
states.meaning: No active maintenance fence; ordinary SQLite operations may seek their own transaction.

states.name: Fenced preparation
states.meaning: Exclusive maintenance owns validated staging and prior-state inventory; ordinary access is blocked.

states.name: Activated replacement
states.meaning: The validated new store is active; cleanup must preserve truthful commitment and cannot roll back as retry.

guards: Exclusive fence acquired after ordinary leases clear.
effects: Retain inspected source/prior state and stage validated candidate.

guards: Current observations and candidate inventory match.
effects: Activate selected staged units and retain displaced originals.

guards: Fresh observed recovery and exact prior units established.
effects: Restore verified prior scope; preserve unrelated bytes.

guards: Retained active candidate and known lock ownership remain valid.
effects: Release owned cleanup/fence; report committed outcome.

constraints: Lifecycle is explicit maintenance, not ordinary transaction history.
Interrupted staging stays fenced; a current observed finish or permitted rollback is required.
Committed replacement is never undone as cleanup retry.
Ordinary no-op updates do not activate this lifecycle.
